tests.testId: Home page has no WCAG2AA errors
tests.description: Runs Pa11y (axe-core + HTML CodeSniffer) against the rendered page via runShell. Pa11y's default --level is error, so only error-severity findings fail this step—warnings and notices are informational, same threshold philosophy as Vale's error-level-only deploy gate. This checks a different layer than the other specs in this suite: they confirm content renders and navigation works, this confirms the rendered DOM is usable by assistive tech (alt text, contrast, landmarks, ARIA) — Vale and Lychee can't see this, and neither can the other doc-detective specs.
